dimensions.assessment: Affects young commercial fishermen, participants in the grant program, the National Sea Grant Office, and related fishing industries.
dimensions.evidence: track the career progression of participants in the Program, identify those who subsequently enter or remain in commercial fisheries

dimensions.assessment: Extends grant program authorizations and adds new training scope areas and evaluation criteria without altering broad national laws.
Reauthorizes funding levels for the grant program through 2031, though specific dollar sums are not stated in the source text.
Amends the Young Fishermen's Development Act to update eligible grant activities, tracking requirements, and authorization timelines.
dimensions.evidence: The Young Fishermen's Development Act (33 U.S.C. 1141 et seq.) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Extends program authorization for a 5-year period covering fiscal years 2026 through 2031.

importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes the Young Fishermen's Development Act from fiscal years 2026 through 2031, expands grant program criteria to include crew management, seafood handling, and waterfront infrastructure, and mandates career tracking.
